findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.gen.pro" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_billing_action, gen_content_action, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action · Private data: gen_asset_action, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_generate, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action, gen_upload_asset, gen_vidsheet_action · Public sink: gen_asset_action, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_task_action, gen_upload_asset · Destructive: gen_analyze, gen_asset_action, gen_characters, gen_content_action, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action, gen_vidsheet_action, gen_voice_action, gen_watchlist_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_billing_action, gen_content_action, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action · Private data: gen_asset_action, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_generate, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action, gen_upload_asset, gen_vidsheet_action · Public sink: gen_asset_action, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_task_action, gen_upload_asset · Destructive: gen_analyze, gen_asset_action, gen_characters, gen_content_action, gen_platform_action, gen_task_action, gen_vidsheet_action, gen_voice_action, gen_watchlist_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
